hypothesis.3aea5e09557249cae5d37df0.distinction: Considered attachments before preference: (1) the final modifier makes the LC's role irrelevant to the entire stated applicability trigger; (2) it makes the LC's role irrelevant within the immediately preceding Type 13 activity condition. Both preserve the same express conditions and produce the same predicate. Restricting the answer to transfer-agent activities would contradict “regardless”; treating that modifier as dispensing with Type 13 conduct would erase an express condition. A further possible extension—treating every operational role as receipt or holding—is undermined by Q3's distinction between operating SPV accounts and receiving or holding their money. No substantive missing rival antecedent is defensible on this text, so one reading is retained. The remaining actor-reference and negative-qualification ambiguities are recorded without manufacturing a second predicate.
